svg.aria-label: A metro map. The semantics, compiler, domain, framework and solver lines each pass through three to five stations and meet at interchanges; a short branch carrying the order analysis joins the domain line at the interchange where the analyses meet; the semantics line runs on into the central interchange, which the result line leaves, ending at three terminals: PROVED, DEAD and SAFE; a lower branch of the result line carries the entry-state policy, and the compiler line meets the result line twice, first at the chain that keeps the contexts, which a branch of the result line reaches from below, then at the headline above the three terminals.

a.data-info: The source semantics: one step rewrites the rest of the program, the store and the caller frames.
Activation traces: each records one activation's path, with its callers and finished callees nested inside.
The collecting semantics: every store some valid activation trace reaches at a node. Every soundness theorem is judged against it.
The compiler from VIMP procedures to a graph with entry and result nodes per procedure.
Forward simulation: one source step is matched by zero or more CFG steps.
Interchange of semantics and compiler: every source run has a matching graph configuration and a valid activation trace ending there.
The compiler line reaches the result: a source run's store is in the collecting semantics at the matched node.
All a numeric domain writes: one bundle of value operations. An evaluator for expressions, two comparison queries, the refinement operations guards use, min and max, and the top value.

The certificate, proved once per domain: the evaluator and min/max are sound, refining never drops a store the condition admits, and the queries answer truthfully. The transfers, the guard filter, procedure entry and the check classifier are built from the bundle, and their soundness follows from this one certificate.
The order analysis joins without a bundle. It records pairs x ≤ y instead of one value per variable, and proves its local specification sound directly.

The executable refinement: the local specification the exported code runs, built from the same bundle over finite default dictionaries, is itself a sound local specification. So the analysis contract holds for the code, not only for its specification.

Interchange of the analyses: what every analysis the analyzer can select proves about its transfers, its query answers, procedure entry and return. The numeric domains get it from their certificate; the order analysis proves it by hand. A local specification reads and publishes no globals.
An analysis as a record of transfer functions: skip, assign, special, branch, body, return, enter, event, combine_env and combine_assign, plus a query handler. Goblint's Spec, in Isabelle.

The boundary of the proof: a dg_spec with a soundness assumption per transfer. Equations, routing and solver soundness are proved once for any analysis meeting it. An analysis that uses globals, such as the order domain of Rel_Order_Domain, meets it directly, without a local specification.
Context policies: every context the semantics admits for a call is one the policy routes some covering alternative to, and that key is solved. Each policy discharges it once.
Interchange of the analyses and the framework: a sound local specification, lifted to a dg_spec, meets analysis_contract. This is where every analysis the analyzer runs enters the proof.
Right-hand sides as trees of queries, side effects and answers.
The vendored, verified top-down solver with side effects, in the locale that takes the global update rule as a parameter. This is the solver every analysis here runs.
The vendored solver's own promise, and the fact each domain's registration uses: whatever the global update rule, a terminating solve answers with a post-solution.
The induction over traces, with no solver and no domain in it: any cover meeting five local obligations contains every store an activation reaches.

The central interchange of semantics, framework and solver: given a post-solution of the routed equations, a sound specification and the context policy's obligations, every store a trace reaches is inside γ of the solver's value.

The result read back from the solver covers the collecting semantics at every node, once the solve terminates, for any route that is a function of the call site, the no-context one included; entry-state contexts take the parallel one through entry_state_lookup_sound_of_terminates.

The entry-state route: fix a terminated solve and read the policy off it. Every valid trace then carries one of its contexts, and each context's stores lie in the state solved for it. The functional route above needs no such policy.

The common point of the results: for the policy the configuration runs with, every valid activation trace carries a context, and every context's stores lie in the report. Both routes lead here; the context-free coverage and the per-context spine both start here.

The report run_voblint returns contains, at every node, every store the collecting semantics has there, for every activation list, update rule and context policy. All three terminals are proved from it, so DEAD and SAFE need no source run.

Interchange of compiler and result: the function the browser calls covers every source run, stopped anywhere. PROVED is the only terminal stated at a source run, so it is the only one routed through here.

The chain with its contexts kept, for every configuration: a source run's store lies in the collecting semantics of a context its activation trace carries, under the policy the configuration runs with; the contexts together are the collecting semantics, and the report and its verdicts contain them. It follows from run_voblint_contexts and the source bridge, as run_voblint_source_sound follows from run_voblint_contexts through run_voblint_covers.

PROVED means the check holds, REFUTED that it fails, in every run that reaches it. It reaches the hub through run_voblint_source_sound, and uses the compiler a second time on top of that: csim_next_check_edge says the check the source is about to run is an edge at the matched node, which no result-line fact can know.

DEAD means no run reaches the check. Proved forwards from run_voblint_covers, not through the source bridge: that bridge runs forwards, placing each run at its node, so it cannot be read backwards into no run reaching a given node.
No diagnostic means no division by zero in any reached store. Stated at the node, over the collecting semantics, so it needs the semantics line but not the source bridge.
